{{Top|leg}}
'''Hot Bespin''' was a configuration in the game of [[Shronker/Legends|shronker]]. It was generally considered the most difficult one. When using this scenario, a hot Bespin orbited extremely close to the primary, whipping about it faster than the others and making it more difficult to send an outlying world caroming to a fiery end.
